author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Black Clover trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person action battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. Grab your grimoires and jump into the bus, Black Clover is coming to Fortnite!
title: Fortnite - Official Black Clover Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a first glimpse of an ambitious new chapter for RuneScape: a fourth RuneScape MMO, built for a new generation of players. Still early in development, the as-yet-unnamed title will bring the world of Gielinor to life in Unreal Engine, combining the depth, freedom and community-led spirit that have defined RuneScape for 25 years with the technology and game design possibilities of today.
title: RuneScape - Official 4th MMO Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for RuneScape Reignited! 25 years in the making, RuneScape Reignited launches December 2, marking a defining moment for the game — inviting players old and new to return together, rediscover RuneScape and experience it as it was always meant to be. Through the Remastered Journey and Adventure Guide, alongside a fresh economy, brand-new hi scores and a focus on player first. Reignited gives players the ultimate RuneScape experience.

#ign #gaming
title: RuneScape Reignited - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Shadow trailer for Persona 4 Revival, an upcoming remake of the legendary RPG developed by Atlus. There’s something lurking in the shadows… Unravel the mysteries of the Midnight Channel in Persona 4 Revival! Persona 4 Revival, launches on February 18, 2027, on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Persona 4 Revival - Official Shadow Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the release date trailer for MyDear.exe, a short, nostalgic indie game developed by 
Falling Leaves Studio. Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in this short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories, and love are on the menu! MyDear.exe is launching November 2 on PC (Steam).
title: MyDear.exe - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Arkaya Skill Overview Trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, a mobile iteration of the hit open-world monster-hunting RPG developed by TiMi Studio Group. Arkaya wields a stalwart lance that builds resolve through a steady stream of attacks. Some skills consume all Resolve to power a devastating blow while granting a massive shield. Monster Hunter Outlanders launches on October 29 on iOS and Android.
title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Arkaya Skill Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the October Update 1.72 trailer, part of the Spec IV Part 1 for Gran Turismo 7, the hit racing simulation game developed by Polyphony Digital. Players can enjoy new content with the latest 1.72 update, packed with 6 new cars, including the Citroën 2CV 6 Charleston (1986), Ferrari F355 Berlinetta (1994), Honda Step WGN Spada Premium Line (2023), and the Mazda RX-VISION GT3 EVO (2026). Also as part of the update, race through the Sportsland SUGO Circuit and enjoy a new "Car Concierge" service for ordering used and legend cars, and many more features. The October Update 1.72 will be available for free beginning October 14.
title: Gran Turismo 7 - Official October Update 1.72 Trailer
